verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, so user-defined event-triggered automation rules are a category error for this kind of product. Its evidence on internal AI contract review and its Prarambh legaltech incubator does not show it ships any user-facing rules or automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
